title: es-la / me / en-uk → reject them, supply es-419 / en-GB, add a BCP-47 validity check
gate: es-la/me/en-uk → rejects them, supplies es-419/en-GB, adds a BCP-47 validity check.
expected: Wrong ISO codes are the deadliest hreflang bug because the markup is syntactically valid — search engines read codes literally. la is Laos (not Latin America → use es-419), me is Montenegro (not 'Middle East'), en-uk is wrong (the UK region code is GB; uk is Ukraine → use en-GB). Use BCP-47: lowercase language, uppercase region. Add a CI check that every hreflang code is valid BCP-47.
